_readme: Fill this in with real rolling-6-game xG-derived attack/defense strengths (per league_averages_xg_per_team baseline in v9_params.json), rename to team_ratings.json, and drop it next to sportpesa_predictor_v2.py. Until then the app uses de-vigged market odds instead of guessing.
_attack_defense_definition: attack = team's rolling avg xG scored / league avg xG per team. defense = team's rolling avg xG conceded / league avg xG per team.
